Package com.example.project3.project2

Class Student

java.lang.Object
com.example.project3.project2.Student
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Student>
Direct Known Subclasses:
NonResident, Resident
public abstract class Student extends Object implements Comparable<Student>
Represents a student with profile, major and credits completed Also has overrides for equals(), toString(), and compareTo() for comparison and manipulation
